headline: Emkay Global Financial Services Limited: Granting/withdrawal/surrender/cancellation/suspension of key licenses/ regulatory approvals
sum: Granting/withdrawal/surrender/cancellation/suspension of key licenses/ regulatory approvals — Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchanges of the Intimation of receipt of trading approval for listing of equity shares…
detail: Granting/withdrawal/surrender/cancellation/suspension of key licenses/ regulatory approvals — Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchanges of the Intimation of receipt of trading approval for listing of equity shares allotted to promoters pursuant to conversion of warrants on preferential issue basis under Chapter V of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue and Capital Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 ( SEBI ICDR Regulations 2015 )
